title: Super Mekabots: A browser mecha card game. Build your deck, bond with your Meka.
author: SupMekBots
selftext:
I'm building Super Mekabots, a browser mecha card game with mechanics mostly inspired by Duel Masters.

When you sign up, you choose your founding Meka. Once you claim it, another player can't choose that same Meka as their founding unit. You also get your own virtual assistant, generated by AI on the fly.

You build a deck and pair a pilot with your Meka. I'm paying homage to the Super Robot Wars series with cinematic attacks set against Indonesian scenery.

I use Claude Design + Codex Astra for design and development, and Seedance 2.0 Pro for the attack animations.

Try the current version: [https://supermekabots.com/](https://supermekabots.com/)



Which Meka would you choose?
